description:
Customize the bullet list on Slide 1 of the presentation '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/release_readiness.odp'. 

1. Change the bullet character from the default dot to a Checkmark symbol (✓).
2. Change the bullet color to Green (hex #008000 or similar standard green).
3. Save the presentation.

Note: You may need to access the 'Bullets and Numbering' dialog via the Format menu or right-click context menu.
